definitions: A distinctive handbag designed by Yves Saint Laurent, characterized by its unique horn-shaped handle and often made from luxurious materials.
A specific model of designer handbag from the YSL brand, known for its iconic handle and elegant design.
examples: She carried her YSL Mombasa bag to the gala.
The vintage YSL Mombasa bag fetched a high price at auction.
Many collectors seek out the rare YSL Mombasa bag variations.
